literal: Even if distress befalls, disgraceful deeds they will not do, those who have a vision free from wavering.
translation: Even when beset by severe distress, those who possess unwavering clarity of vision will not commit deeds that bring disgrace.
modern: துன்பம் வந்தாலும், நடுக்கமில்லாத தெளிவான அறிவுடையவர்கள் இழிவான செயல்களைச் செய்யமாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the strength of character required to maintain purity of action during times of adversity. The key phrase 'நடுக்கற்ற காட்சி' refers to an unwavering clarity of vision or intellect that does not shake under pressure. People with such steady wisdom understand that temporary suffering is preferable to permanent dishonor. Therefore, even when faced with extreme distress, they refuse to perform disgraceful actions to ease their burden.
